info.title: DocTranslate API (Agent Actions)
info.description: Translate text, documents, images, audio and video; run PDF tools; extract/fill forms (data_entry). Async tools return a task_id — poll get_result until status is done, then read the text or download url_download. Auth: header X-API-Key with the user's DocTranslate key.

license.name: Proprietary — for authenticated API-key holders only

post.description: Run one tool from the PDF Tools / PDF Formatter suite (format conversion + utilities) — merge, split, remove/extract pages, rotate, page numbers, watermark, crop, organize, redact, sign, compare, jpg_to_pdf, scan_to_pdf, pdf_to_jpg, word/ppt/excel_to_pdf, pdf_to_markdown, ai_summarizer, protect, unlock, repair, and 6 image tools. Most are FREE; word_to_pdf/powerpoint_to_pdf/excel_to_pdf/pdf_to_markdown/ai_summarizer/repair are PAID. A few tools need specific `options` fields: protect/unlock -> {password}, redact -> {terms}, sign -> {signature_text}, organize -> {order}, watermark_image -> {text}. merge needs 2+ files; most others take exactly 1 (extras are silently dropped). New in this build — v3-only.

post.description: Dispatch one of task_type's families (document/audio/video/images/summarization) against files already priced via POST /upload — referenced by meta_files, not re-uploaded. v3 (current, richest enum tables). task_type "create_video" is explicitly rejected (400) — use /create/transcripts then /create/video instead. summarization accepts exactly 1 meta_files entry.

domain_translate_image.description: Validated but never actually dispatched to the image pipeline today.

domain_create_video.description: Validated but never actually forwarded today.

200.description: Current status (processing) or final result (done/failed) — shape depends on task type, see ResultAny.

400.description: Unknown/invalid task_id (or it does not belong to this API key).

post.description: Translate an uploaded audio/video/subtitle file. PAID. v3 (current, richest enum tables). By default produces a translated transcript only (SRT-equivalent, via process_mode). Set export_audio and/or export_video (added in this build) for a dubbed audio track / dubbed video — pick a voice.

voice.description: Dub voice. Only meaningful with export_audio/export_video. Added in this build.

export_audio.description: Produce a dubbed audio track. Added in this build.

export_video.description: Produce a dubbed video. Added in this build.

400.description: A well-formed but rejected request, or a generic dispatch error.

is_translate_images.description: Also translate images embedded in the document, in place.

style_mode.description: Accepted for contract parity; not forwarded to the worker (no document-side correlate exists).

post.description: Translate a video already uploaded via /v4/upload/presign. Subtitle-only by default (SRT, ~2 credits/min); set export_audio and/or export_video to true for a dubbed audio track / dubbed video — this is the end-to-end video translation capability. PAID. Dub params (domain/tone/dictionary/custom_prompt/export_audio/export_video/voice/audio_format) were added in this build — this endpoint used to be subtitle-only with no way to request dubbing.

post.description: Presigned R2 PUT so a client can upload a video directly, then submit its key to /v4/translate/video. No credit gate — this route only signs a URL, it dispatches nothing.

size.description: Bytes — used for an upfront size-limit check (300MB general cap, 1GB for video extensions).

post.description: Translate an XML or HTML document — multipart `file`, or JSON with a `file_key` from a prior upload. process_mode/is_translate_images/output_format are fixed (replace/false/auto) and not accepted as fields.

200.description: Queued (or, for GET /result, the current status/result).

400.description: A well-formed but rejected request, or a generic dispatch error.

422.description: Missing/bad fields, or more than 1 file sent (this endpoint accepts exactly 1).

file_key.description: Alternative to `file` — a key from a prior upload.

original_lang.description: No trailing null member advertised here (unlike other endpoints' original_lang) — send "None" or omit for auto-detect.

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: Your DocTranslate API key (dtl_...). Ask the end user for it; never hardcode a key.

OptionalLangV3.description: Optional original_lang/source_lang on v3 — omit or null for auto-detect.

LangV3.description: Required dest_lang on v3/v4 endpoints (44 codes = v2 + 13 more).

TranslateTypeText.description: translate_type on /translate/text — identical on every version.

ToneV2V3.description: tone on v2 and v3 endpoints (identical list).

DomainV3.description: domain on v3 text/document endpoints (37 values = v2 + Fast Translation, Games).

cost.description: Always 0 — plain text translation is free.

status.description: Always null on this shape — legacy parity, not a mistake.

SlidesNumber.description: slides_number on /process — STRING values, not integers.

text_credit.description: v1/v2 ONLY — v3 never includes this field.

image_credit.description: v1/v2 ONLY — v3 never includes this field.

is_pdf_scan.description: v1/v2 ONLY — v3 never includes this field.

transcript_urls.description: Only present when type=audio/video: presigned URL to the original-language SRT.

translated_transcribe_urls.description: Only present when type=audio/video: presigned URL to the translated SRT.

url.description: Presigned S3/R2 PUT URL, valid 1 hour.

TaskType.description: task_type on /process and /create/transcripts — identical on every version.

MetaFile.description: References a file already priced via POST /upload (or a cached YouTube link).

task_id.description: The task_id from a prior POST /upload price-check response.

AudioDomainV3.description: domain on v3 /translate/audio (7 values = v2 + Story).

error_description.description: Always empty string in practice — never duplicates errors[0].

CreateVideoResult.description: A single object when task_ids had exactly 1 entry; an array when it had 2+.

DictionaryEntry.description: One glossary override, applied when des_lang matches the request's dest_lang.

ImageDomainV3.description: domain on v3 /translate/images (6 values = v2 + Comic).

type.description: Always the literal string "progress" — even when done.

ValidationError.description: Bare FastAPI/Pydantic validation-error shape — NOT wrapped in the envelope above. FastAPI validates every field at once, so `detail` can carry several entries in one response.

example.detail: Invalid authentication credentials. Provide a valid Bearer Token or X-API-Key.
